name: Mirror Chart Duel
loop: Send a link; both players ride the same masked historical path with paper positions for 3 minutes; higher paper return wins when the ticker is revealed.
hook: Same chart, pure skill comparison, instant rematch link.
risk: Paper P&L rewards overtrading; needs frequency-neutral scoring and paper-only labels.

name: Ghost Of Friday
loop: Race a translucent ghost replaying a friend's recorded up/down calls on the same masked path, seeing their call bubbles appear as you decide.
hook: Beat a person, not a number; ghost timing creates tension.
risk: Ghost calls leak information and herd behavior; reveal only after own call.

name: Best Of Three Paths
loop: Three short masked rounds against one opponent over a day; each round scored by Brier on a direction forecast; take two to win the match.
hook: Series structure gives comebacks and a story arc.
risk: Long async matches may create nagging notifications; cap reminders.

name: Calibration Showdown
loop: Both players set a probability slider on ten identical masked cases; the better-calibrated forecaster wins and sees a shared reliability curve.
hook: Honesty beats bravado; the curve is shareable proof.
risk: Log scoring is hard to explain; may feel punishing to newcomers.

name: Seeded Daily Duel
loop: Everyone gets the same seeded synthetic path today; you swipe long or flat per bar, then see where you rank against your friends only.
hook: A daily shared seed makes dinner-table talk.
risk: Daily streak pressure; no streak rewards, no penalties for missing.

name: Skill Ladder Matchmaker
loop: Queue for an opponent with a similar rating; both trade the same synthetic path; risk-adjusted return decides rating moves for both.
hook: Fair fights near your level feel winnable every time.
risk: Rating chase can drive compulsive queueing; add session cap and cool-down.

name: Replay Booth
loop: Watch a recorded duel move by move with both players' decisions hidden, guess who will win at each checkpoint, then see the true trades.
hook: Learn from others' mistakes with no stakes of your own.
risk: Spectators may copy patterns as signals; replays show only masked data.

name: Relay Of Three
loop: Three friends each take a one-minute leg of one shared masked path, passing the paper portfolio forward; team return is compared with another trio.
hook: Shared blame and glory; hand-offs create drama.
risk: A weak leg may shame one teammate; show team score only.

name: Tug Of Trend
loop: Both sides call each bar up or down in real time; a tug-of-war meter moves with each correct streak and the first to pull it across wins.
hook: Simple, tactile, readable by spectators.
risk: Streak multipliers reward luck runs; cap multiplier and label synthetic.

name: Blind Bracket
loop: Eight friends enter a weekly single-elimination bracket; each match is a three-minute shared masked chart and the winner advances.
hook: Tournament brackets turn small groups into events.
risk: Weekly cadence is fine; ensure no prizes or stakes beyond cosmetic titles.

name: Rematch Reversal
loop: After a duel, the rematch replays the same path with sides swapped: you inherit your rival's first decisions and must improve on them.
hook: Learning from the exact moves that beat you.
risk: Inherited trades may confuse the attribution of skill; label clearly.

name: Verified Shadow Duel
loop: Two players see the same anonymised verified trade setup and each predicts win or loss; reveal shows the real closed outcome and who read it better.
hook: Real records make guesses feel meaningful and honest.
risk: Anonymisation re-identification and trader consent; aggregate and delay heavily.

name: Odds Bluff Duel
loop: Each player sets a probability and a confidence stake in points; a higher-confidence correct call earns more, but a wrong one costs more.
hook: Poker-like tension without money.
risk: Points staking resembles gambling mechanics; keep points non-convertible and uncapped-free.

name: Twin Timeline
loop: Both players drag a range for where the price will land at the end of the same seeded path; narrower correct ranges beat wider ones.
hook: Rewards precision and humility together.
risk: Intervals may be gamed by always-wide; score width and coverage jointly.

name: Sunrise Face Off
loop: Each morning you and a friend each call the next close direction on one broad index; tonight's result settles that day's duel and updates a running tally.
hook: A tiny daily ritual with a friend.
risk: Daily habit loop; no streak pressure and cap at one call. Not a signal.

name: Same Seed Spectre
loop: Race the best recorded run on a seed that the community has played; your live equity curve is drawn over the champion's ghost curve.
hook: Chase a visible target with perfect replays.
risk: Chasing a best run can encourage reckless risk; score includes drawdown.

name: Draft The Day
loop: Players alternately pick masked assets from a shared pool of six; each player's paper basket rides a hidden path and the better basket wins.
hook: Snake-draft banter and bluffing about picks.
risk: Pick order advantage; randomise who drafts first and rematch swaps.

name: Tempo Duel
loop: A metronome ticks; each beat you must lock a call before the beat, racing a friend's ghost whose timing is shown as tick marks.
hook: Rhythm game feel; short and tactile.
risk: Speed pressure could encourage reflexive decisions; label as game not investing.

name: Challenge A Verified Trader
loop: You play a sequence of anonymised closed-trade setups, then compare your accuracy with a consenting trader's own public hit rate on the same set.
hook: Measure yourself against real, verified skill.
risk: Comparison could imply copyable skill; need consent, delay, and no-advice disclaimers.

name: Handicap Match
loop: A stronger player starts with a lower paper cap or fewer trades so mismatched friends can duel fairly; both see the handicap before starting.
hook: Friends of any skill can have a real contest.
risk: Handicap formulas feel arbitrary; display transparent rule.

name: Replay Commentary
loop: Watch a duel replay and pause to attach one-tap annotations like overreacted or held the plan; annotations tally into the players' post-match review.
hook: Gives losers constructive feedback and viewers a role.
risk: Public critique may become harassment; restrict to friends and preset tags.

name: Mutual Fog
loop: Both players see the same path but each sees a different random half of the bars hidden; you can spend a peek token to see what the opponent saw.
hook: Information asymmetry adds bluff and trade-offs.
risk: Complexity; first-time players may not grasp peek rules in 150 seconds.

name: Pair Trade Duel
loop: Each player splits a paper allocation between two masked assets on the same seed; net returns after a shock decide the winner.
hook: Allocation puzzle where insight about relationships wins.
risk: Allocation can read as portfolio advice; keep abstract and masked.

name: Last Bar Standing
loop: You and a friend's ghost ride the same increasingly violent synthetic path; each drawdown past a threshold removes a life, and the longer-surviving run wins.
hook: Elimination tension without the need for big returns.
risk: Rewards sitting still; ensure scoring still values good calls.

name: Live Delayed Showdown
loop: Friends each lock probability forecasts on five delayed-live events for the week; Brier scores resolve later and tally in a weekly head-to-head table.
hook: Slow-burn rivalry with real unfolding data.
risk: Forecasts could be read as predictions to act on; show as game entries only.

name: Scoreboard Of Two
loop: A persistent two-person scoreboard tracks every duel between you and one friend, with streak-free lifetime head-to-head and a favourite-chart gallery.
hook: A long-running rivalry record to revisit.
risk: Obsessive rivalry tracking; allow archive and mute.

name: Speed Round Showdown
loop: One minute, a stream of short synthetic snippets; swipe up or down on each outcome; you and the challenger get the identical stream and compare counts.
hook: Tiny commitment, instantly comparable.
risk: Pure reflex reward may trivialise skill; label synthetic and cap count.

name: Mentor Duel
loop: A veteran and a newcomer ride one path; the newcomer sees the veteran's reasoning notes only after finishing and earns codex entries for each lesson matched.
hook: A friendly way to teach friends.
risk: Mentor reasoning may read as advice; keep notes about process on masked data.

name: Doubles Lanes
loop: Two pairs race on one path; within a pair one partner controls entries and the other controls exits, so the combined result depends on trust and timing.
hook: Co-op tension and banter in a short game.
risk: Blame between partners; show combined result only.

name: Pick Your Poison
loop: Before a duel each player secretly picks a harmful modifier to inflict on the opponent from a short list, such as double volatility or no exits for 20 seconds.
hook: Roguelike curses in a head-to-head frame.
risk: Modifiers could feel unfair or toxic; limit to preset game rules.

name: Rating Replay Court
loop: Your skill rating is an Elo-style number updated from many tiny forecast duels against anonymised past players' recorded answers on identical paths.
hook: Always a match available, always a rating shift.
risk: Rating loops are compulsion drivers; show confidence band and cap daily plays.

name: Chart Courier
loop: You build a custom three-call challenge by picking masked clips, send it to a friend, and earn cosmetics when friends finish it, win or lose.
hook: Creating puzzles for friends is its own fun.
risk: Creator may pick clips that mislead; curate from reviewed library only.

name: Bluff Radar
loop: You see a friend's recorded confidence level but not their direction; decide whether to follow or fade the confidence before making your own forecast.
hook: Reading a person's tone, not just the chart.
risk: Herding on others' confidence; limit to game-only and fade tracked.

name: Season Of Rivals
loop: A six-week season pairs you with one rival per week on shared seeds; points per match add to a season table that resets with new cosmetics.
hook: Seasonal arcs keep rivalries fresh.
risk: Season resets can push grind; no purchasable advantage.

name: Hot Seat Duel
loop: A live-ish arena where two players duel on a seeded path while friends spectate and send preset emote reactions that never affect the score.
hook: Spectators make a short game a show.
risk: Peer pressure from the crowd; mute option and no spectator influence.

name: Opening Gambit
loop: Each player chooses one of six named opening stances for the first thirty seconds, then adapts live; a codex tracks which stances beat which.
hook: Rock-paper-scissors metagame layered on charts.
risk: Stance names must not read as strategies to copy in real markets.

name: Time Warp Duel
loop: You can rewind the shared chart twice; the ghost of your rival used its rewinds at recorded moments, so you compare when each of you needed a second look.
hook: Limited do-overs create tough decisions.
risk: Rewind teaches hindsight bias; show it in post-mortem.

name: Oracle And Skeptic
loop: One player is assigned bull, the other bear, on each case and must argue by call timing; scoring rewards the better read of when a trend turns.
hook: Forced roles spark debates.
risk: Forced side may reward contrarian noise; mix with free rounds.

name: Synchronous Sprint
loop: Two matched players ride the same synthetic path at the same real time; equity curves shown side by side with a hidden last 20 seconds.
hook: Live heartbeat of a head-to-head race.
risk: Real-time matchmaking needs liveness; fall back to ghosts.

name: Review Duel
loop: After a duel, both players predict how their own range would score; the gap between self-assessed and actual accuracy is a second, separate score.
hook: Rewards self-knowledge over bravado.
risk: Meta-score complexity; keep a single plain summary line.

name: Sealed Move Duel
loop: Both players seal an allocation across four masked assets before the reveal; the same path then plays out and the better sealed plan wins.
hook: One decision, big reveal, great for sharing.
risk: Allocation framing could mimic portfolio advice; keep abstract and random.

name: Group Chat Chart
loop: A friend group shares one daily masked chart link; everyone calls it; the group sees a distribution of calls and who read it, then a shared answer.
hook: Zero-friction daily game for a group.
risk: Group pressure to participate; no streak display.

name: Coach Mode Duel
loop: A friend spectates your duel and can send three preset nudges like hold or size down; afterwards the codex scores whether nudges helped.
hook: Social co-piloting and learning.
risk: Nudges look like advice; limit to process words, masked, game-only.

name: Duel Of Disciplines
loop: Before starting, each player commits to a rule such as max three trades or stop-loss; breaking the rule voids the round, rewarding discipline.
hook: Self-imposed constraints make players creative.
risk: Rules could imply they are good practice; frame as game constraints only.

name: Echo Of The Best
loop: Each day a composite ghost made from the crowd's most accurate recorded players runs a seed; beat the ghost to take a daily title.
hook: A beatable boss everyone shares.
risk: Crowd ghost may be mistaken for a signal; reveal only after play.

name: Fast Forward Wager
loop: Each player can skip ahead in time at a cost in points; skipping reveals more of the path but shrinks the multiplier on correct forecasts.
hook: Information has a price, like real decisions.
risk: Points cost mimics betting; keep nonmonetary and clearly gamey.

name: Sudden Death Tiebreak
loop: When a best-of-three ties, a sixty-second sudden death on a fresh seed settles it; the first wrong call loses.
hook: High drama endings to normal matches.
risk: Harsh loss feelings; offer immediate friendly rematch.

name: Co-op Versus Market
loop: Two friends team up against the whole community's median result on a weekly seed; together they must beat the crowd's average, not each other.
hook: Duo cooperation with a shared enemy.
risk: Median comparisons may feel exclusionary; display in bands.

name: Blindfold Rematch
loop: Replay a lost duel with the price axis removed so only shape and your rival's call markers remain; you try to match their winning reads.
hook: A study mode that feels like a game.
risk: None major; ensure still masked.

name: Clash Of Codices
loop: Both players bring a loadout of three unlocked pattern cards from their codex; cards give small in-game perks on the shared path, such as one free rewind.
hook: Collection meets duel meta.
risk: Pay-to-win drift; unlocks only via play, never purchase.

name: Pocket Rivals
loop: Each day you hold three duel tickets; each is a seventy-five second swipe challenge against a friend's posted run; tickets refill over time.
hook: Light, bounded play that fits a commute.
risk: Energy mechanics can nudge purchases; never sell tickets.

name: Roguelike Versus
loop: A three-minute roguelike run of five events with perk picks between them; your friend's ghost took different perks on the same seed and you try to outscore them.
hook: Same dungeon, different builds, direct comparison.
risk: Run randomness could be mistaken for skill; show luck-adjusted rank.

name: Forecast Fencing
loop: Trade parries: you set a probability, your opponent may counter with a different one, and the one closer to the revealed outcome scores the exchange.
hook: Back-and-forth feels like a conversation.
risk: Anchoring on the opponent's number; hide until you commit.

name: Cohort Clash
loop: Adult players join anonymous squads of five; squad average forecast accuracy on weekly seeds is ranked against other squads.
hook: Belonging to a squad adds loyalty and banter.
risk: Squad pressure; confirm 18+ attestation and no private chat.

name: Phantom Tape
loop: Replay an anonymised verified trader's timeline on a masked path as a ghost; at each of their entry and exit points you choose whether to match, then compare.
hook: Sparring with a real, proven style.
risk: Copy-trading optics; delay, aggregate, percent-only, no live link.

name: Shared Reveal Party
loop: A scheduled party where a friend group watches the same masked clips, all lock calls before each reveal, and the reveal screen shows the group's split.
hook: Movie-night energy for charts.
risk: Scheduled events add FOMO; keep recordings playable anytime.

name: Mirror Match Ladder
loop: Each ladder step is a duel against a recorded opponent a bit stronger than you; winning unlocks harder chart types such as gap days and range-bound drift.
hook: Clear next-step goal and an unlock path.
risk: Ladder chasing; free play always accessible.

name: Counter Pick Chart
loop: You pick the market regime for your opponent's chart from trending, choppy, or crash while they pick yours; each must adapt and compare risk-adjusted results.
hook: Strategy about the opponent, not just the chart.
risk: Crash regimes may distress; label synthetic and not predictive.

name: Sealed Envelope Week
loop: Friends seal Monday through Friday close-direction probabilities in advance; Friday reveals all five and the head-to-head Brier winner.
hook: Anticipation and a weekly payoff.
risk: Forecasts could resemble tips; show as game scores, no sizing.

name: Tag Team Rally
loop: Two teammates alternate every twenty seconds controlling one paper position on a shared path against another pair; tag in or out is a tap.
hook: Hand-off tension and shared control.
risk: Slow partner stalls tempo; auto-play fallback.

name: Rival Memory
loop: The game remembers where you and a given rival disagree most and builds each new duel from chart types where your answers differ.
hook: The game feels tailored to your rivalry.
risk: Personalisation must not become a tip; patterns on masked data only.

name: Duel With Fog Of Time
loop: Both players drag a forecast cone before time advances; as bars reveal, the cone narrows by your rule and the ghost's cone is drawn lightly for comparison.
hook: Visual cone battles are intuitive.
risk: Cones can be gamed wide; score width.

name: Bounty Board Duel
loop: Each day three posted seeds have an unbeaten champion; defeat the champion on a seed to take its title until someone dethrones you.
hook: King-of-the-hill with small defend or lose stakes.
risk: Title defense can feel like obligation; titles expire without penalty.

name: Draw Duel
loop: Each player sketches the path they expect with a finger on a blank axis before reveal; the closer overall shape wins the round.
hook: Creative and tactile, easy to show off.
risk: Shape-matching scoring ambiguity; define metric simply.

name: Anonymous Arena
loop: Instantly matched with an anonymised opponent's recorded run on a random masked seed; no names are shown until you add each other after the match.
hook: Low-pressure strangers, easy to find rivals.
risk: Trolling after reveal; friend request is opt-in with block.

name: Coin Flip Mode
loop: A pure noise path duel where nobody can have an edge; the post-game shows why the winner was lucky, teaching variance.
hook: Humbling and educational and funny.
risk: May bore; position as a teaching moment and keep short.

name: Grudge Replay Archive
loop: Browse an archive of the best duels, pause before decisive moments to predict what the players did, and unlock codex notes on why it worked or failed.
hook: A highlights reel you play along with.
risk: Survivorship in highlights; also show worst and average duels.

name: Allocation Arm Wrestle
loop: Both drag sliders live between risk-on and cash blocks while a masked path plays; your slider trace is drawn against the opponent's ghost.
hook: Continuous control feels like arm wrestling.
risk: Cash vs risk framing could mimic advice; masked, abstract blocks.

name: Challenge Chain
loop: Beat a challenge to forward the next harder one to a new friend; each link in the chain adds a small difficulty and shows the chain's lineage.
hook: Viral passing game with a visible chain.
risk: Spam-like invitations; throttle sends and require consent.

name: Stakes Of Pride
loop: Both players wager cosmetic badges they own; the winner gets the loser's badge shown on their profile for a week, then it returns.
hook: Gentle stakes with real social flavour.
risk: Gambling-like wagering; badges non-transferable and not purchasable.

name: Anti-Herd Duel
loop: Score depends on being right while a majority of your friend group is wrong; consensus calls earn little, contrarian correct calls earn more.
hook: Rewards independent thinking in groups.
risk: Contrarian reward may encourage random dissent; cap payoff.

name: Pace Car
loop: A pace-car ghost runs a fixed rule such as buy and hold; you must beat it after drawdown penalties while also racing a friend's ghost.
hook: A baseline to beat shows real skill versus luck.
risk: Baseline could suggest strategy superiority; label synthetic.

name: Duel Draft Night
loop: Friends draft cards representing masked chart setups from a shared pool, then each plays their hand in turn against a house path; best total wins the night.
hook: Draft strategy and table talk.
risk: Complex rules; tutorial in first match.

name: Tournament Sprint
loop: A weekly Swiss-style event with five two-minute rounds against similarly scored opponents, always paired by current standing, ending in a leaderboard.
hook: Tournament structure with a bounded session.
risk: Prizes absent; keep cosmetic titles only.

name: Verified Versus Verified
loop: Consenting traders opt in to a weekly challenge where anonymised closed-trade setups from their own records are posed to the audience, who compare calls with the traders.
hook: Ties the game to the app's real value: verified records.
risk: Disclosure of trades; delay, aggregate, opt-in, consent revocable.

name: Quick Rematch Button
loop: After any duel one tap starts a forty-five second rematch on a fresh seed, with the friend notified once and no auto-queue behind it.
hook: The easiest possible rematch.
risk: Endless rematch loop; show a take-a-break nudge after five.

name: Mood Meter Duel
loop: Alongside each forecast, you rate how emotional you feel; after the duel the game shows whether calm or tense forecasts were more accurate for each of you.
hook: Gamified self-awareness with a rival to compare.
risk: Not a clinical tool; frame as a game and avoid wellness claims.

name: Relay To The Reveal
loop: A five-friend asynchronous relay: each adds one call to one masked chart over a day and passes it on, and the last friend triggers the reveal for all.
hook: A tiny collaborative story with a shared payoff.
risk: One slow friend blocks the relay; auto-skip after a timer.

name: Skill Exam Duel
loop: Both answer ten identical multiple-choice chart-reading questions, such as which of four paths shows a trend break, and compare in a split-screen result.
hook: Familiar quiz duel, low barrier.
risk: Concept quizzes must not read as investment education claims.

name: Long Game Rivalry
loop: Two friends keep a month-long head-to-head on delayed-live forecasts; each day takes ninety seconds and a calibration curve builds up for both.
hook: A slow rivalry with a visible curve.
risk: Daily compulsion; weekly batching option and optional pause.

name: Variance Court
loop: You and a friend's ghost each give probabilities on twenty fast cases; a verdict screen splits your result into skill and luck.
hook: A fair judge that teaches humility.
risk: Skill versus luck estimates may confuse; show a range.

name: Deck Of Duels
loop: Build a ten-card deck of modifiers like slow time or tighter spread, then duel an opponent's recorded deck on a synthetic seed over three hands.
hook: Deckbuilding depth with async play.
risk: Collection grind; all cards earnable free.

name: Sandbox Duel Lab
loop: Design a custom path with volatility and drift sliders, then challenge a friend to forecast it; you are scored by how well their results match your intended difficulty.
hook: Creator versus solver duel.
risk: Custom paths shared as predictions; label synthetic.

name: Survive The Rival
loop: Both players face escalating shocks on the same masked path; your rival's survival time is the target, and each ascension level shortens your allowed idle time.
hook: Escalating tension with a human benchmark.
risk: Ascension grind; cap at a few levels.

name: Scenario Duel
loop: Two players walk through the same branching story of a fictional trader's week, making choices at each turn; endings compared show who handled uncertainty better.
hook: Narrative and comparison blend.
risk: Story must be fictional and not imitate real people.

name: Portfolio Pillow Fight
loop: Weekly, friends rebalance a masked paper basket five times across a compressed history and compare risk-adjusted growth in a friendly table.
hook: Slow-burn strategy contest among friends.
risk: Long sessions; keep skippable and abstract.

name: Spectator Prediction Pool
loop: While two players duel live, spectators forecast who finishes ahead and are scored on calibration, earning a viewer rank unrelated to the players.
hook: The audience plays too.
risk: Spectator pools resemble betting; points only, no stakes.

name: Weighted Dice Duel
loop: Each round both players see a coin whose bias is hidden but hinted by a short chart; they guess the bias bucket and compare who read the hint better.
hook: Pure inference puzzle between friends.
risk: None significant; keep non-financial framing.

name: Conviction Counter
loop: You can change your paper position only three times per duel; fewer changes with the same result tie-break in your favour, rewarding patience.
hook: Constraint makes every move count.
risk: Patience bias could imply never act; vary constraint by round.

name: Whisper Duel
loop: Before each reveal you may buy a one-word hint from the opponent's recorded notes at the cost of points; hints are vague and can mislead.
hook: Trading information like a bluffing game.
risk: Hint text could slip into advice; preset vocabulary only.

name: Arena Spectate Wall
loop: A wall of live duel tiles; swipe to jump between matches, tap to pick a side to follow, and see how your hunches compare with the final result.
hook: Channel-surfing for fun matches.
risk: Endless scroll; end of wall after twenty tiles.

name: Rating Reset Rivals
loop: Each season your rating compresses toward the middle, and you start with placement duels against five recorded opponents of varying strength.
hook: Fresh start every season keeps it open.
risk: Reset anxiety; display earlier seasons as history.

name: Epilogue Duel
loop: Each duel ends with a generated epilogue card telling the match story in plain words plus both equity curves, shareable to friends.
hook: The share card is the trophy.
risk: Card must carry paper-only and not-advice disclaimers.

name: Blind Date Duel
loop: Matched against someone with a fully hidden rating; you both play, then the reveal shows each other's ratings and style tags like patient or active.
hook: Reveal at the end creates surprise.
risk: Style tags may stereotype; derive only from game behaviour.

name: Loser Picks Next
loop: The loser of each round picks the difficulty tier of the next, so a trailing player chooses between safe parity and a risky comeback.
hook: Built-in comeback mechanics soften losses.
risk: Tier choice could encourage tilt; show neutral wording.

name: Parallel Universe
loop: You and a friend each play one of two branching timelines from the same start; after a branch point you see what the other timeline did and what you missed.
hook: What-if envy, resolved with fun.
risk: Hindsight emphasis; label both paths synthetic.

name: Duel Of Streaks
loop: A friend's best correct streak on the seed is a bar to beat; one wrong call resets you, and the multiplier tops at 3x so luck is capped.
hook: Tense run-for-the-record feel.
risk: Streak mechanics are compulsion-prone; cap and no frequency rewards.

name: Hot Potato Chart
loop: A chart is passed back and forth between two friends, each adding one bar-by-bar call before passing; the player who holds it at reveal loses a point.
hook: Silly timing play with asynchronous suspense.
risk: Nudging nagging; limit pings to one per pass.

name: Coach Versus Student
loop: A student forecasts, then a friend as coach forecasts the same case; if the student's final answer moves toward better calibration after seeing the coach's view, both gain codex points.
hook: Rewards good teaching and learning together.
risk: Coach opinions can read as advice; masked data and process-only.

name: Final Bell Showdown
loop: One featured duel a day: all players ride the same masked path, then the community's results are shown as bands and your friends' results sit inside them.
hook: Daily shared arena with social context.
risk: Daily scheduling pressure; no streaks and archive plays.
